description.value: Key-oh Lodge is a 42-room hotel on the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) in Burns Lake, open since 2017, making it one of the newer accommodations in the area and a natural stopover for cyclists travelling between Prince George and northern BC communities. The lodge offers 24/7 front desk service, daily housekeeping, and a spacious parking area large enough for transport trucks and RVs. A sister property downtown (Key-oh Hotel) includes a restaurant and pub.
